purpose: Form AOC-5 is used to give notice of the address at which a company's books of account are to be maintained under the first proviso to sub-section (1) of Section 128.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Prepare the notice regarding the address at which books of account are kept using Form AOC-5.
File Form AOC-5 as required by the Companies (Accounts) Rules, 2014, Rule 2A.
checklist: Ensure the notice is in Form AOC-5.
Verify the correct address at which books of account are to be maintained.
